preprocessing.api_preprocessing_contract: raw ordered features -> training medians -> saved StandardScaler -> model

calibration_interpretation: Uncalibrated model scores. Reliability, Brier score, log loss, and ECE are descriptive estimates on the existing held-out test set; no calibration model was fitted. The test set has few positives and must not be used both to fit calibration and claim independent performance.

scanner_diagnostics.source_artifact_note: The saved Java Design Patterns feature snapshot predates the current Logistic Regression API deployment and its stored legacy scores were generated by the model named in its metadata. The audit recalculates Logistic Regression scores on captured features; this is not a new live scan.
